d: A controversy has erupted after a police personnel was allegedly seen serving food at a feast organised at the residence of Bihar politician Anant Singh. The incident has raised questions about police discipline, duty responsibilities and the use of uniformed personnel for personal or private events. A video showing the homeguard serving food while wearing his police uniform has gone viral on social media. Following the incident, the Superintendent of Police (SP) reportedly took action against the personnel. What exactly happened at Anant Singh's feast? Why was the policeman serving food…
